description: Land Title Settlement Department -  Calling for calims to property of intestate in Divulapitiya D/S Division and other properties
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, specifically calling for claims to properties of deceased individuals and providing detailed land parcel information including cadastral maps, parcel numbers, and land extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category as it concerns property ownership and land title settlement under the Registration of Title Act.
